caption: Quentin Grimes went off for a career-high 47 and hit his 10th three to force overtime as the Lakers rallied from 18 down to beat the Hornets 118-114. Ninth straight win for LA.

beats.text: LAKERS TRAILED BY 18 IN THE THIRD QUARTER
GRIMES HITS IT FROM LUKA DONČIĆ'S PASS
LAKERS WIN 118-114 IN OT · NINTH STRAIGHT

sources.claim: Career-high 47 points, 10 threes (second Laker ever with 10+ after Kobe Bryant), trailed by 18 late in the third quarter, final 118-114 OT, Dončić in foul trouble
10th three with 1.7 seconds left in regulation on a pass from Luka Doncic; Lakers held Charlotte scoreless the final 4:24 of OT; ninth straight Lakers win
